output.summary: Deciduous tree native to southern Mexico, El Salvador, Guatemala, Hispaniola, Honduras, Nicaragua and Cuba. It has succulent stems and fragrant, sticky, cotton-candy-pink flowers packed with hundreds of stamens. In Central America, a highly intoxicating drink is made from the tree, though the part and preparation are unspecified.
